claims.text: Cyclosporine for severe psoriasis: courses of several months (rarely up to 1 year), alternated with other therapies; kidney effects and long-term immune effects limit its use
claims.quote: Cyclosporine can be used for severe psoriasis. It should be limited to courses of several months (rarely, up to 1 year) and alternated with other therapies. Its effect on the kidneys and potential long-term effects on the immune system preclude more liberal use.
